events.physical_location: Nationwide, Cyprus; EAC offices and customer centres
events.summary: EAC employees held a 24-hour strike starting at midnight; offices closed while generation continued with security personnel.

sources.title: RIK: Σε 24ωρη απεργία κατέρχονται από τα μεσάνυχτα οι εργαζόμενοι στην ΑΗΚ

sources.excerpt: Κατά τη διάρκεια της απεργίας, τα γραφεία της ΑΗΚ θα παραμείνουν κλειστά, αλλά η παραγωγή θα συνεχιστεί με προσωπικό ασφαλείας.

sources.title: EAC – 23 April 2026: Island-wide Strike by EAC Personnel
sources.provenance: Electricity Authority of Cyprus press office advance notice
sources.excerpt: all EAC Customer Service Centres and Offices will remain closed due to a 24-hour island-wide strike announced by the Trade Unions.

uncertainties: RIK reports the strike as underway on April 23; no participant count reported.

events.summary: Residents held a peaceful banner protest at a foundation-stone ceremony attended by the president, opposing an EAC pylon/infrastructure near homes.

sources.title: Christodoulides promises review of EAC pylon project after residents’ protest
sources.excerpt: residents from the neighbouring complex gathered to voice opposition to a new electricity pylon and related infrastructure planned close to their homes.

uncertainties: The size of the residents’ group is unspecified.
